receipt.status: passed; no unresolved consequential blocker to declared bounded experiment
receipt.scope: Independent core formulas, source-free controls, fixed historical outputs and code-only phase/provenance-policy review. No hardware audio read, candidate score assessment, optimizer rerun, production/source-tool edits, staging or commit.
formula_review: Eight source offsets -3..4 and integer modulo32 implement circular source lookup. Normalized and raw-direct branches use the same unnormalized sampled Hann-sinc weights.
Forced-base branch equals raw-direct+(1-sum(weights))*leftmostSourceValue. It applies tail-cumulative coefficients only to seven adjacent differences; the circular wrap difference is preserved.

At a continuous source knot k, compact Hann endpoints vanish. The forced-base jump is (1-sum(weights_at0))*(T[(k-3)%32]-T[(k-4)%32]); direct branches stay continuous. This special formula is not asserted for finite64 lookup, whose own bin jump must also be included.
Only fractional kernel lookup is floored to64 bins; nominal f0/Fs phase trajectory remains float64. Exact-bin, interior-bin and source-wrap cases were independently checked.

rho=32*f0/44100 uses declared .5,1/3,.25 cutoff bands at rho1 and1.5. The q.25 branch is checked synthetically at note96; original hardware passages do not exercise it. No fixed output10kHz notch or SH source-rate inference follows.

The reversed sliding-window matrix equals source indices(sample-offset) with offsets-6..6. Independent full scalar synthesis and a non-palindromic13tap valid convolution verify the column direction and slice alignment for all24 definitions.
control_review: The original forced-base continuity assertion was invalid; the retained first failure precedes hardware and the corrected analytic jump is appropriate.

The initial design@knownTaps synthetic truth shared the fitter path. It was replaced by full scalar_value synthesis plus np.convolve(valid), without changing24model definitions. Independent review reference uses separate scalar sums and math.fsum.

A one-basin finite-grid phase-transfer failure was retained. The revised predeclared search evaluates256coarse phases, refines up to16strict cyclic local minima including a global-minimum fallback with3x65grids, and retains the lowest sampled objective. The4096coarse sensitivity uses the same bounded refinement rule.

All12banked planted training cases and36cross-pitch phase/DC-only recoveries meet1e-6 relative waveform-power error;6dense-training comparisons also pass. This review reproduced every frozen recovery without rerunning either optimizer.
20historical predictions from four prior equal13tap comparators reconstruct byte-exactly. They retain earlier coefficients, gain and phases; no historical comparator is refitted.

Five protocol-pinned source-receipt/helper hashes and current tool/proposal hashes match the frozen pre-control receipt. Code places all numerical control gates and historical reconstruction checks before reading/decoding original hardware audio.
fitting_policy_code_review: Only training solves13signed taps plusDC at each phase; their combined gain remains frozen for other passages. Check passages optimize phase only after centering both waveforms, which is equivalent to a DC nuisance.

Source MP3/MIDI hashes, exact five decoded window hashes and original hardware-only detector/reference equality are guarded before hardware fits. New first/second-fold sensitivity retains the same original selected bins.

No candidate alias metric enters waveform fitting, phase search or source mask selection. All24rows, invalid rank/condition rows and unresolved candidate-line flags are retained; selected_model remains None.
limitations: No new hardware result is reviewed or endorsed here. This is an experiment-validity gate, not evidence of an SH-201 output match.
The phase search is reproducible and passes declared planted controls; neither that nor16basins proves a global optimum on every moving hardware waveform.
Only12banked synthetic cases are fitted; direct scalar/FIR/bin checks coverall24definitions. Banked cross-pitch controls exercise all3cutoff branches.
Normalized versus forced-base comparisons alone couple normalization with base substitution; raw-direct versus forced-base rows isolate the latter because their raw weights are identical.
DC centering, same-note overlap, prior exposure to check pitches and an unknown shared source/capture FIR remain explicit limits. Patent authorship does not establish SH-201 implementation.

summary.range_policy: Descriptive extrema include valid training rows only. Invalid rows remain in report and plot without replacement.

fitting.checking: All taps/gain frozen; only phase/DC for each check. No rate/cutoff/table/window choices fitted.

Refineeachseed withthree65pointlocalgrids across+-previous spacing, dividing spacingby32 eachpass. Chooseminimumloss overallevaluatedtrainingphases. No smooth optimizer.

pre_hardware_control_amendments.reason: Forced-base raw approximation can jump at a source knot; the original continuity guard incorrectly applied to it.
pre_hardware_control_amendments.correction: Direct continuous interpolation remains subject to continuity guard. Forced-base right-minus-left jump at new integerk is (1−sum(a_at0))*(T[k−3]−T[k−4]); check this identity instead. Floor64 lookup discontinuity is separately retained, not assumed continuous.

pre_hardware_control_amendments.reason: Full planted waveforms used the fitted design helper; sparse scalar checks were insufficient to claim independent full synthesis. The same run also failed the Fourier floor64 phase-transfer gate before hardware.
pre_hardware_control_amendments.correction: Generate all extended source samples through independent scalar_value; convolve with known taps via np.convolve(valid). Preserve failed phase-transfer guard; no relaxation, no hardware run under failing search.

pre_hardware_control_amendments.reason: One-coarse-basin search failed the source-free Fourier floor64 transfer gate.

Gate remains1e−6; stop if failure persists. Add exact/left/right all64fractional-bin scalar comparisons and20frozenhistoricalpredictionhashchecks.
